snippet.title: Blade | PS1 | 2000 | Video Game US Trailer | LQ/OGR
snippet.description:
US Trailer for the PlayStation version of the Blade video game, based on characters from Marvel and on the 1998 movie of the same name directed by Stephen Norrington.

Published in United States by Activision in 2000 for PlayStation
Developed by HammerHead

Trailer in high quality. Upscaled from the Trailer in original resolution.
Original source of the video is a channel who had this video in 2010 but the creator of this channel doesn't remember who was its name.
